name: app-amber-smart-home-ai-dashboard
title: Smart-home AI dashboard in amber with radial gauge and 3D house
whatItIs: A pale, near-white desktop dashboard with an amber accent. A half-ring gauge of fine lines shows 22°C, a 3D cutaway house sits centre with frosted grey stat cards, a voice waveform card and message card are on the right, a device list has dot-matrix bars, and a line-hatched area chart shows energy use.
whatItMeans: Calm, high-end and technological; the warm amber makes home data feel comforting instead of clinical.
techniques: Draw gauges and area charts with many fine parallel lines instead of solid fills.
Use dot-matrix mini bars as compact data glyphs.
Anchor the layout on a photoreal 3D object with translucent info cards laid over it.
Keep a single warm hue on a white surface with soft shadows.
Give a voice-assistant card its own waveform graphic.
bestFor: AI assistant products with physical objects

vocabulary.definition: A fill made from many thin parallel lines.
A tiny chart drawn with a grid of dots.
A 3D model showing the interior of a building.
A translucent card with a large metric.
